g.text: Dynamic View: Android MCP bridge - Android bridge APK
Finite callback registration; then separate resource subscription
1: POST tools/call: invoke with typed callback bindings
[MCP2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
3: Plan exact registration, cleanup and callback types
4: Admit exact plan with pinned authority and quotas
5: Return Admission; no device effect yet
7: Create provisional proxy, journal and cleanup obligation
8: Register verified SDK/Binder listener with exact argument mapping
9: Return registration result or explicit unknown outcome
10: Return finite registration outcome and subscription handle
11: Final tool result: handle + journal URI; POST SSE ends
[MCP2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
14: Deliver callback; synchronous reply is bounded and local
15: Accept and commit ordered journal event within quotas
16: Coalesce URI update hint after commit
17: GET SSE: subscribed URI-only resource update
18: resources/read cursor-expanded URI for finite page
[MCP2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
19: Finite journal page; separate application cursor
